scientific_integrity: Exact finite-state Perron analysis plus exact symbolic identities and global root-continuity argument. Published Markovian-step transfer formulas are acknowledged as broader background; novelty is restricted to the disconnected stability-domain phase boundary.
scientific_limitations: Scalar, homogeneous, two strongly convex quadratic losses; stationary symmetric anti-persistent two-state sample Markov chain; mean-square convergence only. No independent scientific validation.
title: A sharp heterogeneity threshold for disconnected mean-square stability windows in Markov-sampled quadratic SGD
